snippet.title: Fireside Fables Announcement Trailer - Indie 3D platformer in partnership with Great Ormond Street!
snippet.description:
Fireside Fables is a narrative driven 3D platformer, made in partnership with Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity! Play through your plushies greatest adventures, explore whimsical worlds, and re-find your inner child!

Releasing on PC, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch in Q4 2025.

Wishlist on Steam here - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3365560/Fireside_Fables/?beta=0

Check out our Kickstarter page here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inkforgestudios/fireside-fables

Developed and Published by InkForge Studio.  The Great Ormond Street Hospital logo is property of Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity,  Registered charity no. 1160024​.

Music composed by @snosm  and Cleo - Insta: cleo_constantinou
